actual_proof_use.grounding: On the shifted interval with horizon S=T-epsilon, the lemma evaluates the density at shifted time S-u. Its bar p_(S-u) equals p_(epsilon+S-u)=p_(T-u). Its actual reversed process is bar X_(S-u)=X_(T-u). Thus drift is -b+a prime+a partial_x log p_(T-u), and outside the compact perturbation it is -x/(T-u).

actual_proof_use.grounding: The h-transformed Brownian density is phi_t(h inverse x)/h prime(h inverse x). Substitution t=T-u gives the corrected clock. The coefficient a prime=2h second(h inverse x) is time-independent and nonzero on the same open set, so step5.1 and its genuine refutation are unchanged. On u in [0,T-epsilon], T-u remains in [epsilon,T], preserving every positivity and uniform derivative bound.
